text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find meaning in what people write. NLP is used in translation apps, which change words from one language to another quickly. It also powers sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a message is positive or negative. Another common example is chatbots, which talk with customers online and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, technology can communicate with us in a more natural and useful way every day.
